description: This file declares interfaces for a message dispatcher system, including a client interface and a dispatcher interface that can create clients using a media keys client.

classes.name: IMessageDispatcherClient
classes.description: Interface for message dispatcher clients, providing a virtual destructor.

classes.name: IMessageDispatcher
classes.description: Interface for message dispatchers, providing a virtual destructor and a method to create clients.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new IMessageDispatcherClient instance associated with a given IMediaKeysClient.
